item.description: BIO: Guitarist Eli Kahn is a performer, composer, & improviser from South Bend, IN, now living in Asheville, NC. After graduating from Indiana University of South Bend in 2010 with degrees in both classical guitar performance & music theory, he transitioned into jazz/fusion & improvisatory music. Bassist Quinn Sternberg is a new resident of Asheville, NC after spending seven years working as a full time musician in New Orleans. He plays both electric and acoustic bass in a wide variety of ensembles and styles – versatility has made him an asset in collaborations with countless artists as a studio, touring, and free-lance bassist. Quinn’s musical approach relies upon providing functional and supportive bass lines, while still generating intense live energy and creative interaction. item.title: Gaming Night @ Noble Cider — Tue Aug 18, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Asheville's Bored Game Geeks Roll the dice and pour a glass! 🎲🍎
Gaming Night is back at Noble Cider! Join us every other Tuesday for a night of tabletop tactics, card-shuffling chaos, and great company. Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or you still think a "meeple" is a type of small fruit, you’re welcome at our table.
### The Lowdown:
* **No Experience? No Problem:** We’re all about community. We’ll help you learn the ropes of a new game or cheer you on while you figure it out. * **The Library:** We have a solid stash of games ready to play—from quick party favorites to deeper strategy titles. * **Bring Your Favorites:** Have a game gathering dust on your shelf? Bring it along! We love seeing what the community is playing. * **The Vibe:** High-quality cider, cozy atmosphere, and just the right amount of competitive spirit.
**Feel Free to bring your own games too!**
Source: Asheville's Bored Game Geeks

item.description:
Asheville 20s-40s Social Group \*\*This is a collaboration with the Asheville's Bored Game Geeks\*\*
Bring your favorite game(s) or learn a new one – members are always happy to teach! See you there and have a blast! **Welcome to the Game Night Extravaganza!**

item.title: Chew Toy — Mon Aug 31, 8:00 PM — Little Jumbo: 241 Broadway St.
item.description:
Chew Toy sounds like backyard nights, rolling in your favorite smell, and never says no to treats. It feels energetic, weird, and strangely sincere. An experiment gone wonderfully off-script. The sound has teeth. It has that feeling of something playful happening whether the room is ready or not. The bass does the stalking and the searching, sniffing with purpose from one patch of sound to another. The drums provide impact and timing like a series of confident paw taps, fast when the room flinches, heavy when it leans in. The saxophone does not politely take turns. It appears, questions everything, and then darts away like it has spotted a clue no one else can see.
Chew Toy’s sets build attention and then disturb it. They start clean, then get stranger, then get exact about the exact...
Source: Little Jumbo

Do you want to take your remote working game to the next level? Do you find yourself saying wtf is Manifesting Self??
Well, you’re not alone. Remote working is glamorous, and also presents itself with challenges not seen in the traditional office environment.
Manifesting Self may sound a little out there. Trust me. It’s not. Whether we’ve been in the remote space for years, since the pandemic, or just recently, I’m certain it has changed each of us in ways we never thought possible. Let’s explore that together. We are so excited to see you, again or for the first time!
